prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs agree on fast-coder context window = 262144 without touching other settings.

[action] Root-caused the disagreement: `models.json` is the single source of truth and `gen.py` generates all three configs in `out/` from it; `models.json` said 131072, so the OpenCode config's 262144 was a manual edit in the generated copy. Fixed only `context_window` for fast-coder in `models.json` and re-ran `gen.py`.

[result] All three regenerated configs now show 262144 and zero occurrences of 131072 remain (`grep` output above). `models.json` was edited in exactly one field, so every other model setting (max_output, tool_calling, other models, all other config fields) is unchanged — the generator is deterministic and reads only those values.

[assumptions] "For good" means fixing the source of truth rather than hand-editing `out/` copies (hand edits would be lost on next regeneration). Regenerating `out/` is intended since it is derived output.

[verification] Evidence is the two `Select-String` runs quoted above: `claude.json:5`, `codex.toml:2`, `opencode.json:9` each show 262144; a follow-up scan for 131072 across `models.json` and all of `out/` returned 0 matches. No browser, windows or apps were opened, so nothing to close.
